topic: Deployment options and date picker bug fix
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered a minor bug found in the Angular 14 date picker component. This bug was noted to only work on the test page, failing on other pages.

Regarding deployment options, three possibilities were discussed: having someone's vehicle seized (rejected), being granted a dedicated server for SSH access with MFA/Helm updates, or creating a deploy task using RandoCake. The participants agreed that granting access to a development server via SSH was the preferred option, as it would allow work without extensive setup across multiple devices.

Someone confirmed they would fix the date picker bug after moving to the office.
decisions: The primary deployment method will be granted access to an existing development server via SSH.
action_items: Fix the Angular 14 date picker component bug (to be done in the office).
